name: Projected Terminal Clipboard Review Dialog
description: Requires one explicit, attachment-scoped user decision before a bounded plain-text terminal request can replace the platform clipboard.

states: Inspect the complete bounded UTF-8 text and byte count before approving the one-time clipboard effect.
Cancel, Escape, lifecycle abort, and approval each settle the attachment-scoped decision at most once.

useWhen: A validated OSC 52 plain-text write request has been assigned to this projected terminal attachment.
avoidWhen: The user initiated an ordinary selection copy, the request asks to read the clipboard, or another paste/clipboard review is already active.
invariants: The exact bounded text remains local to the active decision and is never persisted or logged.
No platform clipboard write occurs before approval, and cancellation or lifecycle replacement writes nothing.
Paste and terminal clipboard reviews never stack; a competing request is rejected or settles the older decision safely.
Approval grants only this plain-text request and creates no durable trust decision.
